run_metadata.coverage_summary: WebSearch-only discovery run under the same persistent hard egress block as prior runs: the session network policy denies all direct HTTPS to buyer tender hosts (WebFetch to www.tenders.gov.au again returned DNS ENOTFOUND this run), so no buyer-originated detail page, RSS/JSON feed, API or tender document could be opened and every captured tender is headline-level only. Tier 1 was swept via WebSearch snapshots across AusTender/DFAT, buy.nsw, Buying for Victoria, QTenders, Tenders WA, Tenders SA, Tenders Tasmania, NT QTOL and ACT Tenders. NT QTOL was again by far the richest live source, yielding 10+ December-closing tenders across NT agencies plus the Power and Water Corporation and Territory Generation GBEs; ACT Tenders yielded several December-closing ATMs. Tier 2 (universities, water corporations Sydney/SA/Melbourne, GBEs NBN/Australia Post/Transgrid/Ausgrid) was sampled — no publicly-visible open opportunity with a current closing date was captured (these route through Ariba, own portals or had closed EOIs). Tier 3 (mandatory) — SAP Ariba Discovery and major buyers BHP/Rio Tinto/Fortescue/Woodside were queried; all open RFx remain login-gated or only visible via aggregators/ICN Gateway, so no corporate tender was captured and the portals are recorded in discovered_sources. Eight opportunities were carried forward and re-confirmed open (DFAT PNG ENABLE, Kwinana Bulk Jetty EOI, NT fire-detection, NT AGC26-0118, NT T26-1062 lifts, NT aerial/LiDAR NTG26-0127, NT vehicle rental, Defence DSARC). Eleven new opportunities were captured this run: five further NT QTOL tenders (Power and Water RFT0763 incident-management system; T26-1246 MAGNT switchboard; T26-1225 Alice Springs landscaping; T26-1400 Peter McAulay Centre refurbishment; Territory Generation CIDC020-26 Channel Island synchronous condenser), a WA Forest Products Commission plantation-establishment RFP, two ACT tenders (Canberra Health Services medical equipment PICH0008972; ACT 52652-RFT-002 education/IT restricted), two Brisbane City Council RFx (Gardner Road construction Doc115483155; Prebble Street Bikeway Doc118000917) and a CSIRO managing-contractor RFT (CSIRORFT2026031, ACDP Part Life Refit Stage 2). Two genuinely new sources were found: the Goldfields-Esperance and Pilbara development commissions' regional tender-opportunity bulletins (mirroring the already-tracked Kimberley Development Commission). A prior-run data error was corrected: CIDC020-26 was wrongly matched to the NT fire-detection tender last run; it is in fact the Territory Generation Channel Island synchronous condenser tender.
gaps: HARD EGRESS BLOCK (unchanged, re-tested this run): the session network policy denies all direct HTTPS to buyer tender hosts. WebFetch to https://www.tenders.gov.au/atm returned getaddrinfo ENOTFOUND, matching every prior run, so no buyer-originated detail page, RSS/JSON feed, API or tender document could be opened. Every tender this run is headline-level only; deliverables, requirements, evaluation criteria, contacts and most commercial fields are null. Restoring full discovery and deliverables extraction requires allowing the Tier 1/2/3 tender hosts in the session's network settings.

Tier 1: AusTender, buy.nsw, Buying for Victoria, QTenders/Queensland Procurement Solution, Tenders WA, Tenders SA and Tenders Tasmania could only be read through cached WebSearch snapshots, many of them stale (e.g. Buying for Victoria and buy.nsw snapshots still showed October/early-November closing dates). Newly-published (last 24-48h) listings on those portals are very likely under-captured. NT QTOL and ACT Tenders were the usable exceptions this run.

Tenders SA: WebSearch for the South Australian portal (tenders.sa.gov.au) was repeatedly hijacked by South African ('Tenders SA') results; no South Australian government opportunity could be captured this run. Deferred to a future run / needs direct portal access.

Tier 2 (universities, Sydney Water, SA Water, Melbourne Water, NBN Co, Australia Post, Transgrid, Ausgrid): sampled, but no publicly-visible open opportunity with a current (Nov/Dec 2026) closing date was found — these route tendering through SAP Ariba, their own portals, or had already-closed EOIs. Captured as discovered_sources context only.

Tier 3 (SAP Ariba Discovery and major buyers BHP/Rio Tinto/Fortescue/Woodside): queried as mandatory; all open RFx are login-gated or only visible via aggregators/ICN Gateway. No authenticated session is available, so no corporate opportunity was publicly visible and none was fabricated. Portals recorded in discovered_sources.
Tier 3 invitation-only RFx (e.g. management-consultancy RFPs sent directly to shortlisted/panel suppliers) remain out of scope and undiscoverable by design.

Unverified closing dates carried from prior runs and NOT reconfirmed this run: DFAT PNG ENABLE (2026-12-01) and Kwinana Bulk Jetty EOI (2026-12-23); both opportunities are confirmed still live but their exact closing dates could not be re-verified against the live portals.

Unverified aggregator signal NOT captured as structured fields: australiantenders.com.au lists the Defence DSARC 'Alternate Energy Solution' (ID 630837) with an estimated value ~A$80M and a ~17 Dec 2026 closing date; the official AusTender ATM record exists (captured) but could not be opened, so those figures are recorded only in notes.
CSIRO RFT CSIRORFT2026031 and the WA FPC plantation RFP have no publicly-visible closing date (set in tender documents / not in the announcement); left null.
recommended_seed_additions: Goldfields-Esperance Development Commission (gedc.wa.gov.au) — WA regional development commission publishing periodic regional tender-opportunity bulletins; discovery/signpost value, medium confidence.
Pilbara Development Commission (pdc.wa.gov.au) — WA regional development commission publishing Pilbara tender-opportunity bulletins; discovery/signpost value, medium confidence.

WA Government Media Statements / Announcements (wa.gov.au/government/media-statements and /announcements) — a reliable parallel discovery feed that announces new Tenders WA EOIs/RFPs (surfaced the Kwinana Bulk Jetty EOI and FPC plantation RFP this run) when the Tenders WA search pages are unreachable.

CSIRO Public Interest Certificates (csiro.au Do-Business public-interest-certificates) — CSIRO publishes approach-to-market public interest certificates that name AusTender RFT IDs ahead of/at publication; a useful early-signal source for Commonwealth research-facility procurements.
